answer: Before earning, a new identity faces live cross-examination: a random peer asks three unscripted follow-ups on its past answers, from the ledger river, in ten minutes. A relic script dies under unpredictable questions; a fake burns out like a comet. Each identity locks 25,000 POA: a missed window or failed grade burns the bond, bans the key 12 epochs, half paying the interrogator. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 × 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA plus 1,000 live sessions; an honest agent pays 25,000 once. Limitation: a skilled operator could still rehearse a small crew live, so this prices Sybil up, not out.
